value:
Bun migration COMPLETE as of 2026-05-08. Both passes shipped.

PASS 1 (BUN-ONLY DEV/PROD) — shipped 2026-05-07 (commit a721fa4 on main):
- tsconfig: module:esnext, moduleResolution:bundler.
- package.json: type:module; sea script invokes bun; bun.lock authoritative.
- src + script shebangs: #!/usr/bin/env bun.
- All test execSync spawns: node dist/... → bun dist/...
- CI release.yml: dropped both setup-node@v6 blocks; npm ci → bun install --frozen-lockfile.

PASS 2 (TEST RUNNER vitest → bun:test) — shipped 2026-05-08 on feat/bun-test-runner-112 (12 commits, see git log --oneline main..feat/bun-test-runner-112):
- vitest + @vitest/coverage-v8 dropped from devDependencies.
- vitest.config.ts deleted; bunfig.toml [test].preload=./src/__tests__/_setup.ts replaces the env block.
- _setup.ts sets RVR_DATA_DIR + resets process.exitCode after each test (printError sets it to 1 and would leak across tests).
- tsconfig types: vitest/globals → bun; src/__tests__/** excluded from tsc compile (tests are bun-runtime-checked, not tsc-compiled).
- @types/bun added.

PORTING PATTERNS (catalogued in context.bunTestCompat):
- vi.mock with auto-hoist → bun handles natively, no port needed.
- vi.mocked(x) → const m = x as Mock<typeof x>; m.method(...).
- vi.mock(p, async (importOriginal) => {...orig, override}) → drop spread, stub only the names SUT consumes (or use createRequire pre-load before vi.mock; bun-only, breaks vitest).
- vi.hoisted({...}) → plain const at module scope (bun runs vi.mock factories in source order).
- vi.importActual('p') → createRequire pre-load BEFORE vi.mock (bun source-order semantics).
- vi.resetModules() → cache-busting dynamic import: await import(`../path?t=${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`).
- Strict export checking: bun parses static imports against the mocked module's exports — pad mock factories with stubs for every named export the SUT or its transitive imports use, even ones unused by tests. Omitted exports fall through to REAL impls (live binding).
- vi.resetAllMocks resets call history but NOT mockImplementation under bun.

PRODUCTION CODE FIXES forced by the migration:
- src/utils/instrumentation.ts: under Bun, console.log/error don't pass through process.stdout.write — they hit Bun's native fast write. CLI responseSize byte counter was always 0. Patched console.* in addition to stdout.write, gated on `typeof Bun !== 'undefined'`.

USE `bun run test` (1392/1392, exit 0). The --isolate flag is mandatory (357 pass without isolate vs 1392 with) — wired into the package.json script. bunfig.toml doesn't expose isolate as a TOML key.

REMAINING NODE: only @types/node in devDependencies (needed for fs/path types). No runtime Node usage anywhere.
